entities.summary: Dominica is a sovereign nation in Caribbean, Americas. Its capital is Roseau. Official languages include English. Government: Unitary parliamentary republic. Population: approximately 0.1 million. Area: 751 km². Comprehensive index for Dominica covering Kalinago (Carib) stronghold, Columbus 1493 (named for Sunday), French-British colonial contest, Maroon wars, sugar/coffee plantations, emancipation, only Caribbean island with surviving Kalinago territory, Hurricane Maria 2017 (total devastation), 'Nature Isle' of the Caribbean, and Eugenia Charles (first female Caribbean PM).
